title: Different Auger Types for Soil Drilling
reason: Provides detailed information on auger equipment, soil type considerations, and the decision-making process for renting auger equipment.

tasks.task: Describe the different types of augers and their appropriate soil conditions.

subtasks.text: Explain the one man auger and its effectiveness in soft soil.
Describe the advantages of a two man auger over a one man auger.
Highlight the importance of test holes in determining soil conditions.

tasks.task: Provide insights into soil type considerations for auger drilling.

subtasks.text: Describe the impact of rocky soil on drilling with a one or two man auger.
Explain the challenges with drilling when soil is too dry or saturated.

tasks.task: Share personal experience and decision-making factors regarding renting auger equipment.

subtasks.text: Discuss the number of holes attempted and the success rate.
Explain the rationale for considering renting auger equipment despite limited success.

tasks.task: Conclude with advice on whether to rent auger equipment based on the number of holes needed.

subtasks.text: Suggest that renting auger equipment might be worth it for more than 15 holes to save time and effort.
